retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome portrait of a man in a cowboy hat, featuring a textured landscape band at the bottom and distressed sans-serif display type.
triggerTerms: cowboy hat close-up with landscape footer
excludeWhen: modern minimalist sans-serif without texture is needed
urban or futuristic themes are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A square-format monochrome composition centered on a close-up portrait of a man wearing a light-colored cowboy hat. The lighting is directional, creating deep shadows on one side of the face. The bottom fifth of the frame is occupied by a high-contrast, grainy landscape image of brush and water, acting as a base for secondary text. Primary text is positioned in the negative space to the right of the subject's face.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's hat brim creates a diagonal division between the dark background and the face.
Text is vertically aligned to the right, balancing the subject's left-leaning head tilt.
The landscape footer provides a horizontal anchor to the vertical portrait composition.
High-contrast tonal range links the portrait, landscape, and typography into a cohesive monochrome palette.
coreInvariants: Monochrome (black, white, and grey) color scheme.
Presence of a cowboy hat as a primary silhouette element.
Distressed or weathered texture applied to the typography.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale portrait occupying the left two-thirds of the frame, cropped at the shoulders.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright, high-crowned cowboy hat serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the bright hat to the subject's face, then right to the display text, and finally down to the landscape footer.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, low-key background on the right side provides a canvas for the primary text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark greys in the background and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for the hat and highlights on the face.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone greys for skin texture and landscape details.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between the hat and the background.

letterConstructionRules: Eroded or 'stamped' texture applied to edges and surfaces
characterSpecificRedesigns: G has a sharp, inward-facing spur
R has a straight diagonal leg starting from the bowl
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different scales and textures.
graphicDevices: High-contrast landscape band at the bottom with a rough, organic top edge.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sturdy, condensed proportions and traditional feel.
Provides the necessary weight and condensed footprint.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast monochrome portrait of a man in a white cowboy hat against a dark background, with a grainy, high-contrast landscape of Texas brush and water occupying the bottom 20% of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply distressed, condensed white sans-serif text in the upper right negative space and a smaller, cleaner version of the same font across the landscape footer.

verificationChecks: Is the landscape footer high-contrast and grainy?
Is the cowboy hat the brightest element in the composition?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the distressed texture on the text
Direction of the lighting on the subject's face
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
Original artist name and album title

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the eyes and hat texture
Deep, rich blacks in the shadows

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the subject's face.
Check that the landscape footer has a distinct, organic texture.
Verify the monochrome balance is not too dark to see facial details.
Confirm the typography feels 'stamped' rather than just typed.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Portrait + Cowboy Hat + Distressed Condensed Sans + Grainy Landscape Footer = Traditional Western Aesthetic
